items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: It couldn't have been Satchel Paige -- no, he's a ball player.

ctx.x: First one I heard to do that, was Buck would do that -- rah-bee-bop, bee-bop-boom. Then it come back again -- I don't know, I've forgotten where I first heard that at. I thought Buck started that to my knowledge once but somebody else had started it before that but I've forgotten who it was. It couldn't have been Satchel Paige -- no, he's a ball player. I'll have to think about that.
